notes: Strain PHL628: the digest gives no genotype or strain lineage, so genotype_class, global_regulator_perturbed and strain_group are left out. Medium taken from the design (LB +/- 0.5% L-arabinose); the growth protocol sentence mentioning M9, rhamnose and glucose contradicts it and is ignored. Arabinose is a medium supplement (treatment none); is_control follows the submitters' 'control' (0% arabinose) field. 28 C growth is recorded as growth_temperature only, not as a cold treatment. Planktonic cells after 48 h batch -> late_stationary (inferred); culture mode of the planktonic fraction and oxygen not described. | 2026-11-20: planktonic cells set to growth_phase not_applicable instead of late_stationary: they are the free-swimming fraction of a 48 h biofilm culture (culture mode not described), not a batch culture in a growth phase.
